entries.back_en: As for you, Vanij, you will use your powers of alchemy to hidetrue form and will become a guide to this new world.
entries.note: 'ocultarforma' está grudado (falta espaço) e falta o possessivo 'sua'.

entries.back_en: You will build a city, a symbol of the unity between the peoples of this universe, and in it you will host all the souls you receive, ensuring they never search for me.
